title: Pixel-art snow drifts and glossy ice patches
purpose: Generate a tileable pixel-art snow and ice tile at a chosen art resolution: lumpy drift mounds with lit caps and blue shadows, sparkles, glossy ice patches with diagonal highlight streaks, rims and cracks, and dirt for trodden snow, with per-pixel normal, height, roughness and occlusion maps. Use for 2D winter levels.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python pixel_snow_ice.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: art_pixels
parameters.meaning: Art pixels along each side of the tile; the maps enlarge them with nearest-neighbour sampling.

parameters.name: mounds
parameters.meaning: Snow drift mounds across the tile.

parameters.name: ice
parameters.meaning: Share of the tile covered by ice patches.

parameters.name: streak_spacing
parameters.meaning: Distance between the diagonal highlight streaks on ice, in art pixels.

parameters.name: cracks
parameters.meaning: Number of cracks in the ice.

parameters.name: sparkles
parameters.meaning: Density of sparkles on the snow.

parameters.name: dirt
parameters.meaning: Density of dirt specks on trodden snow.

parameters.name: relief
parameters.meaning: Strength of the per-pixel normal map.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Fresh lumpy snow with sparkles and a few ice patches.

presets.name: frozen_pond
presets.description: Mostly glossy pond ice with cracks and small snow drifts.

presets.name: packed_snow
presets.description: Grey trodden snow with dirt specks, few sparkles and no ice.

presets.name: glacier
presets.description: Deep blue glacier ice crossed by cracks, with white snow patches.

limits: Stylized pixel art with the light from the top left baked into the mound shading and the ice rims; drifts are Voronoi mounds and ice patches thresholded noise, not a snow or freezing model. Streaks are fixed diagonal highlights, not reflections of the scene. Roughness and height are values per drawn class, and the normal map treats each art pixel as a flat facet. Output sizes that are not a whole multiple of art_pixels give art pixels of unequal widths. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate posterized to eighths.
technique_references: Worley cells as drift mounds shaded by the offset from their seed
Ordered dithering with a 4 x 4 Bayer matrix
Thresholded fractal noise for ice patches
Periodic diagonal streaks broken by hashed segments
